post.originalText:
4 years ago today...  my first prompt on Midjourney 3.  

"the corn wizard. Disney Apprentice meets Merlin the magician. Lots of work. Unreal Engine. 8k. Mysterious, Magnanamous, maximum ears of corn behind the corn man wizard in the center of the iconic image"

Today I building an entire simulated Cornytopia world full of agents running around living out the book and the episodes I wrote back in 2022.  

ChatGPT Astra is like magic, bruh.  @badcryptopod
